recipes.title: OLIVE seasoning
method: Heat Spices to smoking in a pan. Add whilst hot into the olive bucket and submerge with remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: O.D.O CHEESE
method: Pour milk into a saucepan. Heat slowly to 45ºC.
Add vinegar, turn off heat and let curdle for 5 minutes.
Strain through cheesecloth and rinse curds with cold water.
Squeeze curds to remove liquid.
Blend in a Robocoupe with salt and cream until smooth.

recipes.title: CRÈME FRAÎCHE
method: Stir together cream and buttermilk in a container and leave at room temperature until thick (24-40 hours, depending on climate; do not stir). Refrigerate until required.

recipes.title: RADISH TOP PESTO
method: Blitz all ingredients in Robocoupe until almost smooth. Mixture should be a touch chunky. Add into 250ml 4x4 & store.

recipes.title: MUMS HUMMUS
method: Blend garlic cloves in a food processor with 200ml water until very smooth. Pour through a sieve and keep the liquid, discarding the puréed garlic pulp. This method gives a smoother result with a gentler garlic taste.
Drain chickpeas, blend until they're reduced to a smooth paste; this will take about 7 to 10 minutes.
Add tahini, the reserved garlic water, salt and cumin and blend well, scraping sides occasionally and adding more water if necessary.
Transfer to a large bowl and whisk in lemon juice (be gentle; you don't want to over-aerate the hummus and lose its dense consistency).

recipes.title: GARLIC TOUM
method:
Blitz garlic, and 1L of oil in a blender until smooth. Add to a large Cambro. Pour remaining oil in slowly. 

 The oil MUST be added slowly. If you split it you need to double the recipe. You CANNOT bring it back.

Add Lemon juice & salt slowly alternating between oil, lemon & salt. Add ice cubes to thin and keep the oil cool. The oil MUST be added slowly. If you split it you need to double the recipe. You CANNOT bring it back.

recipes.title: WILD ROCKET VERDE
method: Pulse ingredients together. DO NOT OVER BLEND.

recipes.title: WHIPPED CAULIFLOWER
method: Cut the cauliflower florets, dice the stem down and boil for 10 minutes until soft. Once cooked drain off and reserve 225ml of the cooking water. blend with all the remaining ingredients. Do it in batches. Once thoroughly combined, add everything into vac bags, seal and refrigerate.

recipes.title: WHIPPED FETA
method: Method Add to the robocoupe with 1kg Greek Feta. Blend until smooth. It will form a thick paste. Add remaining greek yoghurt slowly until whipped into a smooth cream. Add lemon, honey and whip for a further 3 minutes until completely smooth.

recipes.title: MACADAMIA SALSA VERDE
method: Blanch Rocket in rolling water for 20 seconds to set colour. Blitz all ingredients in the stand blender and season with salt & pepper to taste.

recipes.title: WHIPPED CAULIFLOWER
method: Cut the cauliflower florets, dice the stem down and boil for 10 minutes until soft. Once cooked drain off and reserve 225ml of the cooking water. blend with all the remaining ingredients. Do it in batches. Once thoroughly combined, add everything into vac bags, seal and refrigerate.

recipes.title: FERMENTED CASHEW CHEESE
method: STEP ONE: Add Cashews into a vaccum bag, fill with water and salt from step one. Vaccum and leave to ferment for 4 days leave to ferment. After 5 days, drain cashews and reserve the brine. STEP TWO: Add cashews to the blender with miso, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, flaky salt and salt brine and blend until smooth. Blend until smooth and creamy, pour into a bowl lined with cheese cloth. Tie the cheesecloth and hang in the coolroom for a further 5 days to finish fermenting.

recipes.title: ZUCCHINI PICKLES
method: Slice zucchinis and onion through the 2mm blade on the large robocoupe into a large perforated bain. Sprinkle with salt and leave to sit for 2 hours to draw out the moisture. In the meantime make the brine by combining the vinegar, water and sugar. Bring to a boil to ensure the sugar has dissolved. Allow the brine to cool, add herbs and spices and pour over zucchini. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: prawn head CURRY BUTTER
method: Leave butter to soften overnight. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll into logs and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: SUNDRIED TOMATO BUTTER
method: Leave butter to soften overnight. Drain sundried tomatoes through a chinois and reserve the tomato oil. Remove ½ of the tomatoes and blend in the robocoupe into a paste. Remove and add to the butter in a large mixing bowl. With the remaining sundried tomatoes, pulse in the robocoupe into small chunks. Add to the butter and mix thoroughly. Roll into logs and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: GARLIC & PARSLEY (SNAIL) BUTTER

ingredients.text: 6 bunches Flat-leaf parsley leaves, finely chopped
2kg Unsalted Butter cubed and at room temperature

method: Method : Leave butter to soften overnight. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll into logs and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: MISO BUTTER
method: Leave butter to soften overnight. Add onions, miso, garlic, parsley and mustard into the robocoupe and blend until smooth. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll into logs and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: ANCHOVY BUTTER
method: Soften butter (do not melt). Add ingredients in and mix thoroughly. Season to taste if needed. Roll into

recipes.title: BONE MARROW BUTTER
method: Heavily salt the bone marrow and set aside in the fridge uncovered for 24hrs. Wash the salt off the bone marrow & pat dry. In the Pizza Oven roast bones on high for 8mins or until golden brown. Scrape the bone marrow into a large mixing bowl and add remaining ingredients.

recipes.title: MARUKOME CITRUS BUTTER

ingredients.text: 6 long red chillies - seeded removed fine dice

method: Melt butter in a pot, add miso paste and whisk until combined. Add zest from 2 grapefruits and juice. Add fine chilli. Put into a bain and store

recipes.title: TASMANIAN TRUFFLE BUTTER
method: Microplane into room temp butter, add in Truffle Oil & roll into log. Use within 1 week or Freeze to keep for months

recipes.title: CAFE DE PARIS BUTTER
method: Leave butter overnight on the bench to soften. Add all ingredients EXPECT FOR THE HERBS AND BUTTER into the robo and blitz until smooth. Transfer into a large mixing bowl with the herbs and butter and combine. Roll into logs and refrigerate.

recipes.title: HOT HONEY BUTTER
method: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll into logs and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: ESPRESSO CARAMEL BUTTER
method: Leave butter overnight on the bench to soften. Add all ingredients EXPECT FOR THE HERBS AND BUTTER into the robo and blitz until smooth. Transfer into a large mixing bowl with the herbs and butter and combine. Roll into logs and refrigerate.

recipes.title: NDUJA BUTTER
method: Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Roll into logs and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: APRICOT PRESERVE
method: Simmer all ingredients for 3040 mins until reduced by 1/3 and sugar is dissolved.

recipes.title: PEACH PRESERVE
method: Simmer all ingredients for 30-40 mins until reduced by 1/3 and sugar is dissolved.

recipes.title: FENNEL MARMALADE
method: Wash and thinly slice fennel. Take care not to get any green leaves in the fennel as they look like hair when cooked. In large pot, add fennel, vinegar, and sugar. Cook on low heat for 3 hours until golden brown. Stir frequently to prevent burning.

recipes.title: peach & apricot glaze
method: Whisk vinegar, soy sauce, mustard, salt, garlic powder, and water. Add remaining ingredients, simmer gently for 5 mins, stirring constantly.

recipes.title: CITRUS GEL
method: Whisk extremely well on medium high heat until it comes to a boil. Take off heat. Cool for 30 mins and put into a squeeze bottle. Blitz on high, put into a squeeze bottle and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: WATERMELON GEL
method: Whisk extremely well on medium high heat until it comes to a boil. Take off heat. Cool for 30 mins and put into a squeeze bottle. Blitz on high, put into a squeeze bottle and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: SMOKED PINEAPPLE JAM
method: Remove top from pineapples and smoke with skin on in the Traeger for 5hrs @ 75ºc. Char the pineapple on the burners and leave to cool overnight. The following day, remove skin, slice thin on the meat slicer (leave core in) and fine dice. Make the Anises Sugar Syrup by combining the water, sugars, anise and peppercorns in a pot and bring to the boil. Reduce by ¼ and pour over the diced pineapple. Allow to cool. Let sit for 72hrs to macerate.

recipes.title: MANGO & CAPSICUM RELISH
method: Add sugar and vinegar into a large pot and bring up to the boil. Stir until sugar has dissolved. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer on low heat until thickened, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: CHERRY MOSTARDA
method: In a medium saucepan over low heat, gently cook the shallots with a splash of water and pinch of salt until translucent. Add cherries, sugar, red wine vinegar, balsamic vinegar, and water. Simmer gently for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally until cherries soften and start to break down. Add allspice, clove, salt, mustard powder, whole mustard seeds, and Dijon. Stir well. Simmer another 20 – 25 minutes until it thickens slightly but retains syrupy consistency. It should coat the back of a spoon. Taste and adjust—add a touch more vinegar if it’s too sweet, or a bit more mustard powder for heat. Cool & rest: Let cool to room temp. Store in a sterilised jar in the fridge for at least 24 hours before use.

recipes.title: PEA & MINT SAUCE
method: Blanch peas for 1 minute, cook white onion & garlic until soft and translucent. Add all ingredients to the blender and blitz until smooth.

recipes.title: PRESERVED LEMON DRESSING

ingredients.text: 6 whole preserved lemons, rinsed and seeds removed
2 tsp cracked black pepper, to taste

method: Blend until smooth and creamy. Adjust seasoning with a touch more lemon juice or honey if balancing acidity for service. Yields roughly 2L of finished dressing. Keep refrigerated

recipes.title: CHILLI & CARROT SAMBAL
method: Blitz chillis, carrots, ginger and garlic cloves in the robo with the sugar and salt for 4 minutes. Slowly pour in the vinegar until the sambal is smooth. Pour into a sealed container and knock out any air bubbles.

recipes.title: SOUR GRAPE AGRODOLCE
method: In a saucepan over medium heat, bring the 1/4 cup water to a boil. Add the golden raisins or currants and cook for 1 minute. Remove from the heat and set aside, letting the dried fruit soften and plump up. Cook the shallots and garlic and season with salt until softened. Add the vinegar and honey and cook, scraping the bottom of the pan. Add the grapes and thyme and stir to coat. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened and the fruit is softened for about 5 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat. Drain the raisins or currants then mix them into the grapes with the toasted almonds and fresh rosemary. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Pour into a sealed container and knock out any air bubbles.

recipes.title: GREEN TAHINI DRESSING
method: Add kale, mint, coriander, parsley, garlic and oil blend until the oil reaches 63ºc. Pass through a fine chinois and discard any chunky pieces. Add the oil to the Greek yoghurt, tahini and lemon juice. Season to taste.

recipes.title: FERMENTED CHILLI MAYO
method: Add all ingredients to the blender until thoroughly combined.

recipes.title: FERMENTED CHILLI OIL
method: Add all ingredients to a vacuum bag and seal. Hang or store for 14 days.
STEP TWO
Add the bag to the blender with 800ml Olive Oil. Blend until oil reaches 63ºc. Remove from the heat and strain through a fine chinois.

recipes.title: CONFIT GARLIC OIL
method: Set the combi oven to 120ºc. Add the garlic and oil into a deep bain and cook until the garlic is soft and tender.

recipes.title: PRAWN HEAD OIL
method: Set the combi oven to 180ºc, toss the prawns in the tomato paste and roast the prawn heads & shells for 20 minutes until the are a deep red/brown colour. Cover the shells in the oil and cook for a further 20 minutes. Careful strain the oil through a fine chinois and cheese cloth. Store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: CAESAR DRESSING
method: Add all ingredients to a 15L mixing jug. Blitz until smooth. Pour into squeeze bottles and keep refrigerated at all times.

recipes.title: CASHEW & GARLIC CREAM
method: Soak cashews in 500ml of water overnight until softened. Add all ingredients into the robocoupe and blitz until combined.

recipes.title: BASIL OIL
method: To make the herb oil, chop off and discard the heavier stalks, leaving you with about 150g of leaves. Blanch the leaves for 20 seconds in a large pot of boiling water, then remove and plunge immediately into a bowl of ice-cold water. Drain well, squeeze dry and roughly chop. Whiz the herbs in a blender with the oils, Strain through filter. Bag into a piping bag & hang until water separates. Make a small cut at the bottom of the bag, drain the water, pinch to stop the oil from coming out.

recipes.title: LILLYPILLY DRESSING
method: Put all ingredients into a blender and blitz until smooth

recipes.title: CHIVE OIL
method: To make the herb oil, chop off and discard the heavier stalks, leaving you with about 150g of leaves. Blanch the leaves for 20 seconds in a large pot of boiling water, then remove and plunge immediately into a bowl of ice-cold water. Drain well, squeeze dry and roughly chop. Whiz the herbs in a blender with the oils, Strain through filter. Bag into a piping bag & hang until water separates. Make a small cut at the bottom of the bag, drain the water, pinch to stop the oil from coming out.

recipes.title: OYSTER MIGNONETTE
method: Peel the shallots and fine dice (brunoise), pour white balsamic over, stir and bottle.

recipes.title: GOLDEN SHALLOT DRESSING
method: place everything in a jug and blend it till the sugar is dissolved

recipes.title: VINCOTTO DRESSING
method: place everything in a jug and blend it till the sugar is dissolved

recipes.title: CHARDONNAY VINAIGRETTE

ingredients.text: ½ Cup Onion Juice (Blend Peeled Brown Onion With A Dash Water

method: place everything in a jug and blend it till the sugar is dissolved

recipes.title: ‘NDUJA DRESSING
method: Place everything in a pot on low-medium heat and stir until combined. Do not burn the nduja.

recipes.title: JALAPENO & CORIANDER DRESSING

ingredients.text: 2 Cups Loosely Packed Coriander, Stems Removed

method: Combine jalapenos, cilantro, sour cream, garlic, lime juice and salt in the bowl of a food processor. With the motor running, add olive oil and vinegar in a slow stream until emulsified.

recipes.title: ORANGE & GINGER DRESSING
method: Finely dice orange rind, ginger & red chili & combine in a pot with the orange juice, apple cider vinegar, & brown sugar & reduce to half in the pan.

recipes.title: GREEN GODDESS DRESSING

ingredients.text: Sea Salt And Cracked Black Pepper

method: To make the dressing, place the parsley, mint, lemon juice, onion, yoghurt, salt and pepper in a small food processor and process until smooth.

recipes.title: NUOC CHAM DRESSING
method: Combine the fish sauce, white vinegar, sugar and 60 ml water in a saucepan over a medium heat. Stir well and cook until just before boiling point is reached, then allow to cool. Stir in the garlic, chilli and lime juice, then serve. It will keep in the refrigerator for 1 week

recipes.title: MAPLE TAHINI DRESSING
method: Dice & fry shallots & garlic in oil on low heat until soft and translucent. Add to the robocoupe with 1kg tahini, and half of the water. Blend until smooth. It will form a thick paste. Add remaining water slowly until whipped into a smooth cream. Add lemon, honey & salt and whip for a further 3 minutes until completely smooth.

recipes.title: SOUTH ASIAN CRUDO DRESSING
method: Pour all ingredients into a 4x4 and blend with the small robo until combined. Transfer to a squeeze bottle and keep refrigerated at all times.

recipes.title: YOGHURT DRESSING

ingredients.text: 8 Pieces Coriander Root, Cleaned And Fine Dice

method: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Store in a squeeze bottle and serve

recipes.title: COMEBACK SAUCE
method: Pour all ingredients into a 4x4 and blend with the small robo until combined. Transfer to a squeeze bottle and keep refrigerated at all times.

recipes.title: COOL RANCH DRESSING
method: Pour all ingredients into a 4x4 and blend with the small robo until combined. Transfer to a squeeze bottle and keep refrigerated at all times.

recipes.title: WHITE WINE BUTTER SAUCE
method: Method Add shallots, white wine, vinegar into a pot and cook on medium heat until reduced by ⅔ . Add cream, cook down by ½. Add salt, pepper, lemon juice & oil. Turn off the heat and add cold cubed butter and stir until emulsified. Run through a fine sieve and store for service.

recipes.title: BUTTERMILK DRESSING

ingredients.text: Salt and pepper to season (pinch each)

method: Whisk together mayonnaise, sour cream, buttermilk, lemon zest, lemon juice, minced garlic, and salt and pepper to taste until smooth.

recipes.title: QUINCE DRESSING
method: place everything in a jug and blend it till the sugar is dissolved

recipes.title: CHERMOULA
method: Toast seeds in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant. Add all ingredients to a robocoupe and pulse until well combined, but not too smooth.

recipes.title: HOT HONEY & POMEGRANATE SAUCE
method: Whisk together all ingredients and store in a squeeze bottle.

recipes.title: TOMATO KASUNDI
method: Peel and chop the garlic and ginger, crush the coriander seeds, finely chop the chiles, dice the onions, and peel, core, and cut the apples into 1/3-inch cubes. Gently warm the vinegar in a small saucepan, add the mustard seeds, remove from the heat, and let infuse for 15 minutes. Place the garlic and ginger in a blender and pulse briefly. Add the mustard-vinegar infusion and blend to a smooth paste. Heat the oil in a large heavy-based saucepan over high heat for 1 minute. Remove briefly from the heat, then add the coriander, cumin, turmeric, cumin seeds, cloves, and chili powder. Cook over moderate heat for 20 seconds, then add the mustard-vinegar paste, chiles, and onions. Fry for 5–10 minutes. Drain the tomatoes and add to the pan with the apples and sugar. Lower the heat and simmer gently for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

recipes.title: FENNEL REMOULADE
method: Add fennel, red onion & capers to the robocoupe and blitz until finely chopped. Strain off liquid, add juice from 4 lemons and fine chives to mayonnaise and mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: SPECIAL SAUCE
method: Combine all ingredients into a mixing bowl & blend. Store in an airtight container

recipes.title: LEMON SAUCE
method: Add all ingredients into the bar blender and combine until smooth. Store in an airtight container. Heat to serve.

recipes.title: WHIPPED TAHINI SAUCE
method: Dice & fry shallots & garlic in oil on low heat until soft and translucent. Add to the robocoupe with 1kg tahini, and half of the water. Blend until smooth. It will form a thick paste. Add remaining water slowly until whipped into a smooth cream. Add lemon, honey & salt and whip for a further 3 minutes until completely smooth.

recipes.title: SHELLFISH CREAM
method: Add shallots and prawn shells to the pot with oil. On medium heat cook until prawn shells are red. DO NOT BURN THE ONION. Add white wine to the pot once cooked and reduce by 2/3. Strain through an oil filter and return to the pot. Add cream and cubed butter and whisk until butter is emulsified. Add lemon juice and salt to taste.

recipes.title: BREAD SAUCE
method: Add chilli, garlic & shallots into a pot on low heat and cook until translucent. Add white wine into a pot, increase the heat and simmer until reduced by 2/3rd. Add butter in portions and whisk until melted. Tear up bread and put it all into a blender. Add milk and blend on high until smooth. Return to the pot and add cream and lemon juice. Whisk constantly until thickened. Be careful not to burn the sauce. Season to taste. Store in a 3 Bain under the heat lamp.

recipes.title: REALLY F*CKIN HOT SAUCE

ingredients.text: 1kg Scorpion Chilli (4% salt to water ferment - 7 days)

method: Ferment the Chilli in 4% salt (40g) & water (1L) ratio for 7 days. Drain the chili & keep 500ml of the Ferment Water. Add chilli’s, AVC and xantham gum into a blender and blitz until smooth. Pour into a large pot, add remaining liquids and bring to a gentle boil of 83°c for 10 minutes to sterilise and kill fermentation. Pour into a Glass Bottles and seal with sealing lid tightly. Add to a deep hotel pan in the combi oven. Completely submerge in water. Turn the combi on to 140ºc and set the probe to 93ºc. When temp has hit 93ºc run the oven for 8 minutes. Open the door and allow to cool completely before removing and refrigerating.

recipes.title: HARISSA SAUCE

ingredients.text: 12 Guajillo Chilli Dried (Soak In Hot Water 30 Mins)

method: Soak Guajillo chilli in hot water for 30 minutes. Toast the seeds in the pizza oven until aromatic and brown. Blitz in the blender until fine. Set aside to cool. Add paprika & cayenne to the spice mix. Add 1 tin Roast Capsicum to the spice mix and blitz until a smooth, fine paste. Empty out into a large mixing bowl. Drain the guajillo chilli, cut off the stem and add to the blender with the final tin of capsicum, salt, lemon and blitz. Add the oil in slowly from the top. Once mixed into a smooth liquid, combine both into the mixing bowl and mix until combined. Store in vacuum bags in the fridge.

recipes.title: BEARNAISE SAUCE
method: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. Simmer gently over medium-low heat for 2 minutes. Remove from heat, and let stand for 5 minutes. Strain and press solids to extract liquid—yield approx. 150 mL infused vinegar. Cool for 5 minutes before use.
STEP 2 – BEARNAISE SAUCE
Ingredients:
325g Pasturised Egg Yolk (room temp) 9g Flaky Salt 150ml Infused Vinegar (recipe from Step 1)
1.35kg Unsalted Grass Fed Butter
7.5g Finely Chopped Tarragon
7.5g Finely Chopped Chervil 90ml Water (for thinning)

In the blender, combine egg yolks, infused vinegar, and salt. Blitz briefly to combine. On high, slowly drizzle in hot melted butter over about 60–90 seconds. After all butter is in, blitz for another 10 seconds. Add water 1 tbsp (15 mL) at a time, blitzing between each addition, until sauce is thick but pourable. Stir in chopped tarragon and chervil just before serving. NOTE: ONLY USE PASTEURIZED EGGS IN THE BEARNAISE SAUCE, PUT INTO A STAINLESS BOWL OVER BOILING WATER AND WHISK UNTIL THE MIXTURE IS BETWEEN 62°C AND 64°C. DO NOT BOIL!

recipes.title: horseradish TARTARE SAUCE
method: Mix all ingredients thoroughly with mayonnaise. Store in squeeze bottles.

recipes.title: WHIPPED TAHINI SAUCE
method: Dice & fry shallots & garlic in oil on low heat until soft and translucent. Add to the robocoupe with 1kg tahini, and half of the water. Blend until smooth. It will form a thick paste. Add remaining water slowly until whipped into a smooth cream. Add lemon, honey & salt and whip for a further 3 minutes until completely smooth.

recipes.title: MACADAMIA XO SAUCE

ingredients.text: 300ml Prawn Head Oil – see recipe above
650ml Confit Garlic Oil - see recipe above
600g Sopressa Salami – fine dice or blitz’d

method: Add sopressa, nduja, anchovies and prawn head oil into a deep pan or pot and cook on medium-low until the sopressa has softened, being careful not to burn the mix. Add the remaining ingredients into the pan and cook for a further 10 minutes until the macadamias are slightly softened. Allow to cool and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: JAPANESE FERMENTED CHILLI SAUCE
method: Blend fermented chilli, garlic, wines & sugar until thin. Add to a pot. Add sugar and sake, cook on low heat until sugar has dissolved and sauce has slightly thickened. Fine strain whilst hot through a chinois and store.

recipes.title: WHIPPED TAHINI SAUCE

Add remaining water slowly until whipped into a smooth cream. Add lemon, honey & salt and whip for a further 3 minutes until completely smooth.

recipes.title: CLOUD CURD SAUCE
method: Blitz shallots, cornichons & garlic into small pieces. In a large mixing bowl add all ingredients and mix to throughly combine. Taste to season and adjust if necessary.

recipes.title: MINT & SHALLOT SALATA
method: In a bowl add your chardonnay vinegar and brown sugar and whisk until combined. Finely chop your fresh mint and shallots and add them to the bowl. Toss them in the sweetened chardonnay vinegar.

recipes.title: PARSLEY GREMOLATA

ingredients.text: 8 bunches fresh flat leaf parsley chopped fine

method: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl. Adjust seasoning to taste. Keep refrigerated

recipes.title: SQUID INK AIOLI
method: Blitz all ingredients until thoroughly combined.

recipes.title: DILL & LEMON MAYO
method: Whisk all ingredients until thoroughly combined.

recipes.title: GARLICKY YOGHURT

ingredients.text: 60ml water, plus extra as needed for consistency

method: Whisk all ingredients until thoroughly combined.

recipes.title: MAC & CHEESE SAUCE
method: Melt butter, add flour and brown. Add milk to make a roux. Add all remaining ingredients and cook until cheese has melted. Whilst hot, blend with a large roubostick until smooth. Allow to cool and portion into 130g portions.

recipes.title: CHIP SHOP CURRY SAUCE
method: Melt the butter in a large pot on medium. Add onion & carrot. cook it down until it softens & begins to colour. Add the chopped apple and garlic. Fry for 3 minutes until the apple softens. Stir in the curry powder & Chinese five-spice and fry for 30 seconds. Pour in the chicken stock & stir in the vinegar, salt and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and use a hand blender to blitz until smooth. In a small bowl combine the cornflour with 1 tbsp cold water. Stir this into the curry sauce then turn the heat back to medium. Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened. Check seasoning, adjust if needed, then serve up and enjoy.

recipes.title: DIANE SAUCE
method: Brown onion, garlic until golden. Add red wine reduce by 1/2. Add gravy mix to thicken. Add Worcestershire. Bring to boil reduce by 1/4. Add cream. Stir until thickened

recipes.title: BEEF JUS
method: Sweat the shallots on a medium heat being careful not to colour. Once translucent, add the beef stock & red wine and cook on high until it has reduced by 2/3. Fine strain through a chinos and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: MUSHROOM SAUCE
method: Brown onion, garlic & button mushrooms until golden. Add red wine, reduce by 1/2. Add gravy mix to thicken. Reduce by 1/4. Add cream.

recipes.title: CHICKEN JUS

ingredients.text: 2 X Whole Celery Head Roughly Chopped
2 Bunch Flat Leaf Parsley Roughly Chopped

method: Roast the chicken frames and vegetables in the oven until golden brown. Add to the large stockpot with herbs and apple cider vinegar and simmer on low heat for 10hrs. Strain through a chinois and return the pot to low heat. Add Butter, and lemon juice and cook until liquid has reduced by ⅓ . Season with Salt & Pepper. Set aside to cook and serve.

recipes.title: GREEN PEPPERCORN SAUCE
method: Brown onion, garlic until golden. Add peppercorns & red wine reduce by 1/2. Add gravy mix to thicken. Reduce by 1/4. Add cream.

recipes.title: DUCK JUS
method: Brown onion, garlic until golden. Add peppercorns & red wine reduce by 1/2. Add gravy mix to thicken. Reduce by 1/4. Add cream.

recipes.title: 5 SPICE SEASONING
method: Combine all ingredients into a mixing bowl and thoroughly combine.

recipes.title: CALAMARI FLOUR
method: Mix all ingredients thoroughly until evenly combined.

recipes.title: MACADAMIA DUKKAH
method: Toast black pepper, fennel, cumin & coriander seeds. Grind lightly, leaving it slightly coarse. Toast sesame seeds & macadamia seeds SEPARATELY. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.

recipes.title: FRIED CHICKEN FLOUR
method: Combine all ingredients in a Cambro and mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: SALT & VINEGAR SEASONING
method: Combine all ingredients into a mixing bowl and thoroughly combine.

recipes.title: CRACK SEASONING
method: Combine all ingredients in cambro and mix thoroughly.

recipes.title: LOCAL PORCHETTA
method: Method DO NOT SCORE THE SKIN!!! Split and roll the porchetta out into 3. Add the ingredients across the meat and roll back up into a tight log. Tie the porchetta in 1.5cm ties and put it in the dry-aging cabinet for 4 days to dry the skin out.
TO COOK

Oil and salt the skin with flaky salt. Cook at 220°C for 20 minutes —reduce the temperature to 175°C and put in the probe set to 75°C—making sure the probe is in the center of the roll in the thickest part of the meat. Cook until the internal temperature has reached 75°C. Remove from the oven and allow to rest for 30 minutes prior to cutting.

recipes.title: BEEF RENDANG - STEP ONE

ingredients.text: 10 lemongrass stalks (white part only), finely chopped
3.5kg beef oyster blade, cut into 5cm cubes

method: PART ONE

Toast the coconut: Dry-roast 150g desiccated coconut in a large frying pan over medium heat until evenly golden (5-7 minutes), stirring occasionally. Set aside to cool slightly. Prepare the spice paste: Using a large mortar and pestle (or food processor with 100ml water if needed), pound 150g ginger, 100g galangal, and 10 stalks of lemongrass to a smooth paste. Add 40 long red chillies, 30 golden shallots, 25 garlic cloves, and 150g turmeric. Pound to a coarse paste. Set aside. In a separate clean mortar and pestle, pound the toasted coconut until slightly glossy. Set aside. Cook the spice mixture: Heat 500ml vegetable oil in a large wok (or deep-sided frying pan) over medium-high heat. Add the spice paste and stir often until aromatic (about 5 minutes). Brown the beef: Add 3.5kg beef oyster blade and stir occasionally until well browned (5-7 minutes).
SEE NEXT PAGE

recipes.title: BEEF RENDANG - STEP TWO
method: PART TWO

Simmer the curry: Add the toasted coconut and cook for 1 minute. Pour in 2.125 litres coconut milk, 3 tbsp caster sugar, and 2.5 litres water. Bring to a boil, stirring continuously to prevent curdling. Slow cook: Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender (about 2 hours). Thicken the sauce: Remove the beef with a slotted spoon and set aside. Stir the sauce over medium-high heat until very thick (20- 30 minutes). Finish & serve: Return the beef to the wok, stir gently, and season to taste with salt. Serve with steamed long-grain rice and steamed Asian greens.

recipes.title: NBH SPICY PASTRAMI
method: Soak the brisket in water for 24 hours, changing the water 3 times. Drain and pat the meat dry. Preheat the oven to 150°C. Place the brisket in a deep roasting tin along with the rest of the ingredients. Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours. Reduce the heat to 110°C and cook for a further 4 hours, or until soft and giving When prodded with a chopstick. Check the meat every so often and add more water to the tin if the cooking liquid is evaporating. To make the pastrami spice mix, In a pan, place the coriander, star anise, cloves and all the peppercorns and roast them for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant. Remove the pan from the oven and leave to cool. Use the spice grinder to finely grind the spices. Mix in the rest of the spice mix ingredients. Set aside. After 4 hours, remove the brisket from its liquid, pat it dry and coat liberally with the spice mix. Place the pastrami between two trays and weigh down the top tray with Some tins of food or a cast-iron pan. leave to cool overnight in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: LEBANESE LAMB SKEWER
method: Method Semi-Freeze the lamb shoulder for 3hrs. Run the shoulder through the meat slicer and cut .5mm thick slices. Cut slices into squares and skewer to 150g weight. Put the skewers into a hotel pan and cover with your garlic oil, paprika, thyme and sumac. Allow 5hrs to marinate or even better overnight! Cook your skewers in a ripping hot pan or on your griddle top BBQ. Cook your lamb until medium rare and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Spread your hummus onto the plate, press into the centre to create a divot for your sauce to sit. Stack your lamb skewers up and cover with the mint & shallot salata, fried chickpeas and flaky salt to season.

recipes.title: CHARRED OCTOPUS
method: Method Bring a large pot of water up to the boil and add the oranges, limes & octopus into the put. Cook for 40 minutes on a rolling boil. At 40 minutes, turn off the heat and allow the octopus to cool to room temp in the same water. Once cooled, skewer through the middle of the tentacle to allow it to set straight in the fridge overnight. The following morning, remove the skewer, and cut into bite sized pieces.

recipes.title: BRAISED BEEF CHEEKS

ingredients.text: Mix Salt & Pepper, Sprinkle over Beef Cheeks and put into the
Traeger Smoker for 5hrs on 100ºc. Spritz occasionally with ACV
(Apple Cider Vinegar). Remove the Cheeks after 5hrs.

method: Cut the onion, carrot & celery into your mirepoix. Cook on medium heat until softened. Do not burn or colour. This will take approx 40mins. Add garlic & tomato paste and cook for a further 5 minutes. Transfer to a large, deep bain and fill with beef cheeks and remaining ingredients. Cook for 6hrs on 110ºc. Remove from the heat and allow to cool. Portion each cheek into a vaccum bag with a ladle of liquid and vaccum seal. DO NOT VACCUM THE CHEEK HOT!!! IT WILL SQUASH

recipes.title: CREAMY POLENTA
method: Method Add all ingredients EXCLUDING BUTTER & MASCARPONE into a deep hotel pan and stir to combine throughly. Steam on 100ºc for 50mins. MAKE SURE TO STIR HALFWAY THROUGH. Add butter, marcarpone, parmesan and remaining 1L milk at the end and stir to combine. Allow to cool and portion into 350g vac sealed portions bags.

recipes.title: RICOTTA BUTTER BEANS
method: Brown off the onion and garlic on medium heat with the 100ml olive oil.
Add tomato & white wine and cook off the alcohol.
Add the beans and water and cook on a low temperature for   3hrs until thickened. Stir occasionally so the beans do not stick to the bottom and burn.
Add butter & parsley and cook for a further 10 minutes until butter has melted.

recipes.title: TIRAMiSU OUR WAY
method: 1. For coffee syrup, stir coffee and sugar in a small saucepan over low heat until sugar dissolves (2-4 minutes). Add brandy and amaretto, stir to combine, then set aside to cool slightly (10-15 minutes).
2. Lay savoiardi on a deep tray, spoon over coffee syrup, and set aside until absorbed (5-10 minutes).
3. Meanwhile, for zabaione, whisk yolks, sugar, Marsala, and 1 tbsp water in a heatproof bowl over a saucepan of simmering water until pale and thick (2-4 minutes); set aside to cool.
4. Whisk mascarpone and crème fraîche to combine, then fold through zabaione.
5. Whisk egg whites in a separate bowl until soft peaks form, then fold through the mascarpone mixture.

6. Lay half the soaked savoiardi in a 25cm-diameter serving dish, spread half the mascarpone mixture over and dust with cocoa, then repeat. Refrigerate for flavours to develop (2-4 hours), then serve dusted with extra cocoa.

recipes.title: STICKY DATE PUDDING
method: Add 1100g dates, 1500ml guinness, 330g trecle, 84g bi carb into a pot and cook down to a jam consistency on low heat (approx 10mins).

To make the Batter, combine 435g unsalted butter, 1350g dark brown sugar, in a robo and start the creaming process, add 20 whole eggs, one at a time. Once incorporated add 1050g plain flour,100g bi carb, 65g All Spice & 50g ginger.

When all incorporated, fold batter in a large bowl with date jam with 330g chopped walnuts. (dont chop them too big or they will sink to the bottom). Line 3 large hotel pan with greaseproof paper and bake in the oven for 50 min or until the poke stick is clean. Whilst cooking make the glaze in a large pot, reduce 400ml Guinness & 530g caster sugar until sticky and thick.
When the cake comes out of the oven, pour the hot glaze over the cake and brush to soak in.

STEP TWO - TO MAKE THE SAUCE 
Add Butter, Sugar, Treacle & Golden Syrup into a pan. Cook over high heat until sugar is melted and starts to bubble. 

Add Vanilla Essence & cream, bring it up to the boil and take off the heat. Store in a squeeze bottle.

recipes.title: CHOCOLATE CREMEUX
method:
STEP ONE - CREME ANGLAISE

In a saucepan, add the milk & heavy cream. Heat over medium. Heat until the milk starts to steam. Make sure to regularly stir to prevent the milk from burning. In a medium bowl, place the egg yolks, sugar, salt, and vanilla.
Whisk very well until the egg yolks become very smooth and start to turn pale in color. Once heated, remove the milk from the stove and it’s ready to be added to the egg mixture.

Before adding all the milk to the eggs, they must be tempered. Carefully pour the hot milk mixture in a thin stream into the egg mixture, making sure to constantly whisk the egg mix as the milk is poured in.

When about half of the milk is added to the egg mix, the egg mixture will be warm enough and tempered. Whisk it once more to make sure all the egg yolks are mixed in well (while scraping down the sides of the bowl).
Pour this egg & milk mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining milk. Whisk well to combine.

Lower the heat on the stove to a medium low. Take the pan on and off the heat regularly so the custard doesn’t cook and thicken too quickly. Continue to stir with a spatula until the custard has thickened to the right consistency approx. 8mins making sure to scrape down the sides of the saucepan.
The custard is done when it is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon with a film of custard approx 82 – 85°C. Once the custard is cooked, remove it from the heat.
STEP TWO - CHOCOLATE CREMEUX
Once the custard is cooked, pour the custard through a sieve into the bowl with the chocolate. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a lid for about 1 minute.

Uncover and stir the mixture with a spatula or whisk and mix the melted chocolate with the pastry cream. Stir until the chocolate has completely melted. Once the chocolate has melted add the butter and stir until completely melted.
With a stick blender, blend the chocolate cremeux to emulsify until it is smooth and shiny.
Cover the cremeux with plastic wrap, making sure that the plastic wrap is in contact with the entire surface so as to prevent a skin from forming on top.
Transfer the chocolate cremeux to the fridge to completely chill, or until it reaches room temperature. Once at room temperature, pour piping bags and seal.

recipes.title: RUM CARAMEL
method: Add sugar into a pot with water. Cook down until dark brown. Add cream slowly and whisk. Add cubed butter and whisk until combined. Pour into a sheet pan and refrigerate. Once cool and solid, put into the robocoupe, add 200ml rum and whip to a smooth paste. Put into piping bags and refrigerate. Note - BAG will not freeze due to the alcohol content

recipes.title: HOT HONEY HONEYCOMB
method: Add sugar, water & hot honey to a pot, stir to dissolve the sugar. Bring up on medium heat moving the liquid around to stop burning in spots. If you get sugar on the sides of the pot, brush down with a pastry brush with cold water to stop burning. Using the stick thermometer heat the liquid to 150°c. Add 2 teaspoons of baking soda and whisk vigorously until combined. The honeycomb will triple in size. Turn the heat off and pour into a lined ½ hotel pan. Allow to cool at room temperature for a few hours. Break into pieces and store in an airtight container on the counter.

recipes.title: RASPBERRY & HAZELNUT BLONDIE

ingredients.text: 300g Gluten Free Flour, Spooned And Levelled
6g Flaky Salt (Save To Sprinkle Over The Top Once Cooked)

method: Preheat oven to 175ºC. In a large saucepan over medium heat, melt butter, whisking as it bubbles. When it foams, add milk powder and whisk for 30–60 seconds until it turns amber and smells nutty. Let it bubble 30 seconds more, then remove from heat. Stir in chopped chocolate and oil to melt.
While cooling, whisk eggs and brown sugar in a large bowl for 90 seconds until sugar is fully dissolved (test between fingers). Whisk in powdered sugar until smooth, then add vanilla.
Once the butter mixture is warm (not hot), whisk it into the egg mixture. Switch to a spatula and fold in flour and salt. If warm, let batter rest before adding chocolate chunks to prevent melting.

Prep a bain marie dish: spray and line with parchment covering bottom and sides. Pour in batter, spread evenly, and top with chocolate chunks, raspberries & hazelnuts. Bake 24 minutes, then immediately slam pan on a hard surface for fudgier texture.
Cool for 90 min at room temp or 1 hour in fridge. Sprinkle with 6g flaky salt, flip out onto a rack, remove parchment, flip upright, and store.

recipes.title: BROWN BUTTER BROWNIES

ingredients.text: 264g gluten free flour, spooned and leveled

method: Preheat the oven to 175ºc. Add the butter to a large saucepan and place over medium heat. Allow it to melt and then continue to whisk as it starts to bubble. Once it starts to foam up, add in the milk powder and quickly whisk. After about 30-60 seconds, it should start to darken into an amber colour and give off a nutty aroma.
Add in the cocoa powder and quickly whisk to combine. Allow the mixture to bubble for 30 seconds, then remove from heat and mix in the chopped chocolate (to melt) and oil.

While the chocolate butter mixture cools, whisk together the eggs and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl. Vigorously whisk until the sugar is fully dissolved (about 90 seconds of fast whisking). Test to see if the sugar is dissolved by rubbing the mixture between two fingers. Stop whisking when you can no longer feel the sugar granules.
Add in the powdered sugar and whisk until completely smooth. Mix in the vanilla.

recipes.title: PIZZA DOUGH
method: Split 3 jugs of water evenly. Melt yeast in one jug of water in a mixing bowl. Add the remaining 2 jugs of water once the yeast has dissolved. Set aside 2L of water for later. Add flour to the bowl and mix until the dough starts to form. Add all of the salt and the remaining 1L of water slowly. Once the dough has absorbed all of the water, add the oil slowly until combined. Check the dough temperature constantly, ensuring it stays between 23°C to 23.5°C. Stop the mixer when the dough is at the correct temperature and the oil is fully mixed in. Remove the dough from the mixer and cover it with cling wrap to prevent drying out for 24 hours. After 24 hours, cut the dough into 300g balls, roll them, and place them in a container for another 24 hours. Two hours before making pizza, take the dough out of the fridge to allow it to come to room temperature.

recipes.title: NBH FOCACCIA
method: Split the 1.91L water evenly into 3 jugs (approx. 637ml each). Dissolve the yeast in one jug of water in the mixing bowl. Add the remaining two jugs of water after the yeast has fully dissolved. Set aside the 255ml reserved water for later. Add the flour and mix until the dough begins to form. Add the salt, then slowly add the reserved water until fully absorbed. Gradually pour in the olive oil and continue mixing until well combined. Constantly check dough temperature; it should remain between 23°C–23.5°C. Stop mixing once temperature is correct and dough is fully combined. Remove dough, cover tightly with cling film, and rest for 24 hours. After resting, divide into 2 x 2.1kg dough balls, roll, and store in covered stainless bakers trays. Rest again for another 24 hours in the fridge. Remove from fridge 5 hours before cooking to come to room temperature. After 3 hours, stretch from the middle and up, allow the dough to stick together, turn ½ and repeat. top, and bake! Allow to rest for 2 hours, press with your fingers to the side of the tray, coat in generous oil on the top, season with your preferred toppings Pre-heat your oven to 220ºC. Spritz the top of the focaccia with water and cook for 20 minutes

recipes.title: CHINESE CALAMARI SALT
method: Combine all ingredients into a mixing bowl and thoroughly combine.

recipes.title: CONFIT VEGETABLES
method: Blend all of the vegetables together and place into a Vac Bag. Seal & Steam overnight on 90ºc

recipes.title: CHILLI CRUNCH
method: Put the dried chilli in the robocoupe and blitz to rough chop. Put the chopped chilli into a steam bain and shake to remove the seeds. Throw away the seeds. Put the dried chopped chilli, fried shallots, fried garlic, star anise, cardamom pods, ginger, sugar, salt and stock cubes. Set aside. In a large saucepan, place the sliced garlic and the oil. Cook on medium heat, allow the oil to heat up and start sizzling. Gently continue cooking the garlic for another 2-3 minutes or until the garlic is just golden. Turn the heat off and allow the oil to cool for 2-3 minutes. Then carefully pour the warm oil over the chilli mixture. Mix until well combined.

recipes.title: OPEN SKIES PINEAPPLE BRINE
method: Add all ingredients into a large pot and bring up to the boil. Stir until sugar has dissolved. Allow liquid to cool before adding pineapple.

recipes.title: PICKLING BRINE
method: Add all ingredients into a large pot and bring up to the boil. Stir until sugar has dissolved. Allow liquid to cool before adding cucumbers.

recipes.title: PUFFED SOURGHUM
method: Heat oil on the stove top to 190ºc, put the sorghum in a sieve in small portions and drop into the oil and cook until puffed. Drain onto paper towels to soak excess oil off. Once all cooked, let cool, pour into a large bowl and sprinkle with the seasoning. Shake to combine.

recipes.title: ballina pipi butter
method:
Place the pipis, white wine, half the shallots, half the garlic and thyme in a covered saucepan. Cook over high heat for 2–4 minutes, shaking occasionally, until the shells open. 
Remove the pipis immediately. Strain the cooking liquid through muslin or a coffee filter to remove sand and shell fragments. 
Remove the pipi meat from the shells and finely chop it. Discard any pipis that did not open. 
Place the strained liquor in a clean saucepan with the remaining shallots and garlic. Reduce gently until approximately 80 g remains. Cool completely. 
Beat the softened butter until light. Gradually mix in the cold pipi reduction. 
Fold through the chopped pipi meat, chives, parsley, lemon zest, lemon juice and pepperberry. 
Check the seasoning. The pipi liquor will already be salty, so only add salt after tasting
Roll into logs or store in a sealed container under refrigeration. For service efficiency, it can also be portioned and frozen

recipes.title: VERJUS MIGNONETTE
method: Peel & fine dice banana shallots. keep these as small as possible. Add to a large squeeze bottle.
Add Verjus over the top and allow to sit.
Add toasted & cracked black pepper and shake bottle to mix throughly.

recipes.title: MARIE ROSE COCKTAIL SAUCE
method: Add all ingredients into a large mixing bowl and thoroughly combine. Season to taste.

recipes.title: MANGO & GINGER CRUDO SAUCE
method: In a large mixing bowl, combine the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, hot water and rice vinegar in a bowl. Mix thoroughly to dissolve the sugar, taste and adjust to balance

recipes.title: cured egg yolk
method: Add 1kg of fine salt to the bottom of a 100mm hotel pan. Use the end of the eggshell to create 30 individual deep divets in the salt.
Crack and seperate each egg yolk from the whites and gently place each yolk into its own divet.
Cover the yolks with the remaining 1kg of fine salt and allow to cure for 7 days in a room temperature environment

recipes.title: whipped ricotta
method: Add all ingredients into the Robocoupe and mix until thoroughly combined.
Scoop into large blue piping bags and store in the cool room

recipes.title: YUZU MAYO
method: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and throughly mix. Store in squeeze bottles in the cool room.

recipes.title: spicy tomato vodka sauce
method: In a large saucepan, cook onion, garlic on medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato sugo, red pepper flakes, and cook for 10 minutes on medium heat until tomato sugo has darkened in colour.
Add the vodka and cook for a further 8 minutes until the alcohol has cooked off.
Add the thickened cream and mix. Cool the sauce and blitz until smooth.

recipes.title: FERMENTED PINEAPPLE & CHILLI GLAZE
method: Peel the pineapple, then cut it into 2 cm cubes, keeping the core. Transfer to a large bowl.

Add the lime zest and juice, followed by the salt, crushed coriander seeds and sliced chilli. 

Mix thoroughly, gently squeezing the ingredients together by hand to release plenty of juice.
Pack the sambal into large vaccum bags, leaving 1 cm of space at the top. Ensure the pineapple is completely covered by the liquid.
Vaccum tightly and let sit for 4 days to ferment. Keep an eye on the bag.

recipes.title: CHICKEN FAT GRAVY

ingredients.text: 1 x 2.5kg Bone Roasters Chicken Jus 25 Brix

method: Heat chicken jus in a large pot and add 225g chicken powder and heat until thickened.
Store in a sealed container in the cool room.

recipes.title: burnt apple sauce
method: Cut apples into halfs and remove the seeds and stem.
Toss in the vinegar and cook them in the combine oven for 20 minutes on 200ºc or until soft.
Add the unsalted butter and blend in the Robocoupe into a smooth puree.
Pass through a fine sieve to ensure there are no lumps. Store in a squeeze bottle in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: truffle mayo
method: Add all ingredients into a large mixing bowl and whisk until combined.
Store in squeeze bottles in the cool room.

recipes.title: fire roasted banana pudding
method: BANANA PUDDING CREAM
Make the banana cream, whisk yolks, sugar, Marsala, and 1 tbsp water in a heatproof bowl over a saucepan of simmering water until pale and thick (2-4 minutes); set aside to cool.
Whisk mascarpone and crème fraîche to combine, then fold through banana cream.
Whisk egg whites in a separate bowl until soft peaks form, then fold through the mascarpone mixture. Leave to cool in the cool room.
MISO RUM CARAMEL
Add sugar into a pot with water. Cook down until dark brown. Add cream slowly and whisk.
Add cubed butter and whisk until combined. Pour into a sheet pan and refrigerate.
Once cool and solid, put into the robocoupe, add 200ml rum and whip to a smooth paste. Put into piping bags and set in the cool room. Note - BAG will not freeze due to the alcohol content
TOFFEE BANANAS
Slice the bananas into thick 1/2cm chunks. Lay on a flat tray and dust with caster sugar. Using the blowtorch, caramalise the sugar on top of the bananas.
TO BUILD

Add everything into the serving bowl and build in thin layers in this order. 

1. Zabaione Cream
2. Savoiardi Biscuits
3. Bananas
4. Miso Rum Caramel 
5. Zabaione Cream
6. Savoiardi Biscuits
7. Bananas
8. Miso Rum Caramel 
9. Zabaione Cream

recipes.title: Whipped coconut cream
method: Add coconut cream and ice sugar into a large mixing bowl and whip until combined throughly.
